Protocol.hypothesis: Cash-market opening introduces new inventory/liquidity. Overnight gap acceptance in first30 minutes may predict next120 minutes. One pooled standardized five-feature ridge model, not calendar means, closed breakout/reversal rules or BDP1 cells.
Protocol.independence: Globally exposed development; neither AIP1 nor BDP1 calendars are independent confirmation.
Protocol.input: M5 Pepperstone CFD bid OHLC/tick counts; tick count is not exchange volume; no claim of auction print or official cash index.

model.costGate: abs(mean)-2*weeklyJackknifeSE-2*current/development minimum-volume cost scenario>0; baseline1x sensitivity disclosed never selected
features: overnight gap / prior10 complete cash session mean range
log first30 tick-count / prior10 first30 tick-count
model.fit: All26 development weeks, only labels matured strictly before boundary; zero-centred slope prior, no parameter grid
model.marginal: All remove-one-asset conditional cost proxies, no refitting. Not financed marginal NET.
model.priors: Ten complete prior cash sessions. Missing expected session clears warmup; future missing labels retain earlier forecasts.
model.selection: One complete predeclared portfolio recipe, no winner asset selection. Any cost-admitted selection episodes require authentic quote-priced common-capital replay before any economic promotion.
model.uncertainty: Leave-one-development-week-out jackknife; minimum20 training weeks and200 pooled labels, at least2 assets with40 labels; each predicted asset needs40 labels

Protocol.pilot: Current terms/minimum-volume margin first. Fixed first10 three-day chunks plus oldest/middle/late windows, no outcome scoring. Expand only if at least2 current-financeable assets have>=3 complete feature episodes in first30 days and>=2 viable cost contexts. Retain all asset failure reasons. No favorable replacement.
Protocol.pricing: Only after causal primary plans exist: predeclare all required selection entry/holding/exit windows, budgets and common risk before authentic execution pricing. Bar labels are never simulated fills. FundedNet remains null until that phase.
